messages:
marie-marketing: Quick sync 10101 1 1Pricing & packaging experiment next week: goal is cleaner FAQ, tier-name test, and a calculator that feeds better inbound routing. I sketched a short plan. Thoughts?

leo-growth: sounds good. Are we prioritizing existing trials for the soft launch?

marie-marketing: yes 1 soft launch to trials + selected newsletter cohort, then public blog + benchmark post 8-12h later. webinar 4 days after public post.

nina-cs: please include two FAQ callouts: (1) overage calc example, (2) dedicated capacity SLA. I can draft both. Also want a "request pricing review" quick button that routes to CS triage.

dave-product: tier-name A/B test: Group A uses simple names (Basic / Pro / Enterprise), Group B uses outcome-focused names (Cost-Saver / Scale / SLA). Expose via ?pkg_variant=A|B. Keep labels short.

ada-ops: routing plan: calculator returns a numeric score (0-100). If score >= 85 then post to #sales-pricing with hashed trial id and score. If score between 60-84 add to nurture queue. Need field names: utm_campaign, calc_score, pkg_variant.

events-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-calc-v3 -> canary 2026-06-11T15:30Z. Flags: ?pkg_variant, ?calc_score.

marie-marketing: blog/benchmark outline: 1) lead with a single stat (e.g., "up to 40% token cost reduction"), 2) methodology snapshot (how we measured hosted vs dedicated), 3) calculator walkthrough, 4) CTA to webinar + demo. Leo can you assemble visuals?

leo-growth: on it. Ill produce 3 compact charts: cost/kg token vs latency, cost per 1M tokens across configs, and a customer snapshot bar.

dave-product: UX asks: calculator share links should preserve variant and input state; shareable links must redact emails (use trial_hash param). Also show a short explanation tooltip for calc_score.

nina-cs: for the CS triage webhook payload, include locale and inferred ARR bucket if available. Helps SDR prioritization.

ada-ops: will implement webhook to POST /hooks/pricing-lead with {trial_hash, calc_score, pkg_variant, locale, arr_bucket}. High-score leads -> #sales-pricing-high channel.

marie-marketing: microcopy A/B tests for hero line: A: "Estimate your monthly inference cost" B: "See predictable pricing for production". Secondary CTA test: "Book a demo" vs "Get cost estimate".

leo-growth: also propose email subject variants for soft-launch: S1: "New: pricing calculator to estimate cost & savings" S2: "See how Redwood inference fits your budget". We can A/B these against cohorts.

dave-product: small implementation snippet for persisting variant (to add to init):

```
const v = getParam('pkg_variant') || localStorage.getItem('pkg_variant');
if(v) localStorage.setItem('pkg_variant', v);
```

marie-marketing: decision checklist: 1) soft launch to trials + newsletter cohort, 2) public blog 12h later, 3) webinar D+4, 4) A/B tier names via ?pkg_variant, 5) routing: calc_score>=85 -> sales-high, 60-84 -> nurture, 6) FAQ microcopy update, 7) share-link persistence + redaction. If no objections by EOD Ill trigger canary.

leo-growth: :thumbsup: from growth.

nina-cs: :thumbsup: will drop FAQ copy by 09:30.

ada-ops: canary health check will be posted in #marketing-staging.

marie-marketing: thanks team 1 :rocket: Ill post the launch checklist doc and tag owners.
